senses.gloss:
ऋतु ऋ + तु, m.
 1. Order (ved.).
 2. Right time, Chr. 288, 3 = Rigv. i. 49, 3.
 3. A season (of the year), Man. 3, 217.
 4. The menstrual discharge, MBh. 14, 2739.
 5. The season approved for sexual intercourse, Man. 3, 46, sqq.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἀρτύνω for ἀρτυν-ϳω, ἀρτύς, ἀρτύω.

ऋतुमती ऋतुमती, i. e. ऋतु + मन्त् + ई, f.
 1. A woman in her courses, Suśr. 1, 317, 4.
 2. A marriageable girl, Man. 9, 89.
 3. A woman in the period approved for sexual intercourse, MBh. 1, 750.
ऋतु- + काल ऋतु- + काल, m. 1. seasonable time, MBh. 3, 14763. 2. [] time approved for sexual intercourse, Man. 3, 45.
ऋतु- + गामिन् ऋतु- + गामिन्, adj. approaching one's wife at the due time, Bhāg. P. 7, 12, 11.
ऋतु- + पर्ण ऋतु- + पर्ण, m. a proper name, Nal. 8, 25.
ऋतु- + मुख ऋतु- + मुख, n. the commencement, or first day of a season, Rām. 2, 105, 23.
ऋतु- + लिङ्ग ऋतु- + लिङ्ग, n. the peculiar [] marks of the seasons, Man. 1, 30.
ऋतु- + समय ऋतु- + समय, m. season proper for conception, Pañc. 74, 18.
